overview: Medford School Committee Vice Chair Jenny Graham joined the podcast to review recent school district developments, including teacher contract negotiations, health curriculum updates, student disciplinary policies, and upcoming facility projects.

items.title: Favorite Local Restaurant
items.summary: School Committee Vice Chair Jenny Graham shared her appreciation for local restaurant Bistro 5.

items.title: State of the City Address Summary
items.summary: Graham summarized her State of the City remarks covering K-12 curriculum work, union contracts, high school challenges, and the McGlynn playground project.

items.title: Teacher Contract Negotiations and Schedule Changes
items.summary: Graham discussed the four-year teacher contract settlement and noted the district's plan to eliminate Wednesday early releases.

items.title: Health Curriculum Review and Advisory Committee
items.summary: Graham and the hosts discussed the Health Education Curriculum Advisory Committee's work to update puberty education and implement comprehensive bullying prevention programs.

items.title: High School Climate and Safety Plans
items.summary: Graham addressed ongoing safety and climate challenges at Medford High School, emphasizing student engagement and sustainable long-term support structures.

items.title: Discipline and Suspension Policies
items.summary: Graham explained district rules surrounding suspensions and expulsions, advocating for structured in-school suspensions to maintain student learning and support restoration.

items.title: McGlynn Playground and Medford High School Building Projects
items.summary: Graham expressed enthusiasm for the McGlynn Playground designs and reaffirmed her commitment to replacing Medford High School while making needed immediate repairs.
